brief.topic: Agent self-service collaboration control plane for multi-device multi-agent co-design and co-work

criteria.question: Does the project support publishing available work, discovering eligible work, claiming a work item, publishing a result, and handing review to another Agent?
How are private and shared Agent context separated, persisted, and referenced?
How are Agent identity, project scope, ownership, and access boundaries represented?
What service, transport, storage, deployment, and recovery model supports heterogeneous Agents across devices?
What product-health and coordination observability is provided?
What protocols, SDKs, CLI or MCP interfaces, extension seams, licenses, and upgrade responsibilities are provided?
What evidence shows the project can support a narrow first Experience Version?

discovery.query: multi-agent collaboration shared context task claim handoff coordination
